newsitem.title: FINLAND: TRADE IN AMER SUSPENDED -HELSINKI BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: TRADE IN AMER SUSPENDED -HELSINKI BOURSE.

text.p: Trade in the shares of Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy was suspended on Tuesday at the company's own request, the Helsinki Stock Exchange said.
An Amer spokeswoman said the company's board would meet on Tuesday to decide on "these ownership changes".

She was asked if the suspension of trade in Amer shares was linked to the sale of vote-strong K-shares to British investor Jonathan Bryan Guinness, third lord Moyne, by one of the four Finnish institutions which control the unlisted K-shares.
Amer may exercise its right to redeem the shares.
A statement would be released in the afternoon, the Amer spokeswoman said.
On Monday, Amer shares rose 2.30 markka to close at 91.30.
